2607.22953.title: Share No More Than the Request Requires: Federated Disclosure for Perspective-Aware AI
2607.22953.paper_summary: Modern AI systems bring societal risks such as mass surveillance, extreme concentrations of power, and loss of user autonomy---calling into question a model where third-parties collect and control massive amounts of user data. Users require a sovereign system to securely own, govern, and disclose their context while remaining compliant across regulated domains with strict provenance, interpretability, and policy adherence. Perspective-aware AI approaches this by transforming a user's aggregated personal data into a structured identity model called a \emph{Chronicle}: a temporal knowledge graph that represents and grows with the user. Chronicles support the secure disclosure of context across federated networks. A Chronicle holder may expose a queryable, authorized view that a third-party agent may consult without centralizing anyone's data. This paper explores the problem of minimum-necessary disclosure across domain boundaries: when a requester's agent queries a Chronicle, how can the system constrain its response to release only what the requester's relationship, stated purpose, and specific task require? We propose \textbf{Provenance Preserving Chronicles} (PPC), a federated protocol that compiles each holder's Chronicle into a compact \emph{authorized evidence subgraph} governed by one rule: \emph{share no more than the request requires}. Holders keep local sovereignty; an access controller projects relationship-aware views over domain-expert ontologies; and a two-phase flow returns provenance-linked text first, releasing raw artifacts only after explicit holder approval. We frame the problem, map gaps in blockchain, P2P, and holder-sovereign designs, define the core constructs, and sketch the protocol with an explicit threat model.
2607.22953.paper_summary_zh: 現代的人工智慧系統帶來了社會風險，例如大規模監控、極端的權力集中以及用戶自主權的喪失——這使得第三方收集和控制大量用戶數據的模型受到質疑。用戶需要一個主權系統，安全地擁有、管理和披露他們的背景，同時在受監管的領域內遵守嚴格的來源、可解釋性和政策遵循。具備視角感知的人工智慧通過將用戶的聚合個人數據轉化為一個結構化的身份模型來解決這個問題，這個模型稱為\emph{Chronicle}：一個隨著用戶成長的時間知識圖譜。Chronicles支持在聯邦網絡中安全地披露背景。Chronicle持有者可以暴露一個可查詢的授權視圖，第三方代理可以在不集中任何人數據的情況下進行查詢。本文探討了跨域邊界的最小必要披露問題：當請求者的代理查詢一個Chronicle時，系統如何限制其回應僅釋放請求者的關係、聲明目的和具體任務所需的內容？我們提出了\textbf{Provenance Preserving Chronicles} (PPC)，這是一個聯邦協議，將每個持有者的Chronicle編譯成一個緊湊的\emph{授權證據子圖}，由一條規則治理：\emph{分享不超過請求所需的內容}。持有者保持地方主權；訪問控制器在領域專家本體上投影關係感知視圖；而兩階段流程首先返回與來源相關的文本，僅在明確的持有者批准後釋放原始文檔。我們框定了問題，繪製了區塊鏈、P2P和持有者主權設計中的差距，定義了核心構造，並以明確的威脅模型勾勒出協議。
